{{modding player guide header}}

==For players==
See the [https://smapi.io/mods mod compatibility list] to check your mods!

To update your mods:
# For each mod you have installed, check the [https://smapi.io/mods mod compatibility list] for instructions. If it's not listed, try updating to its latest version.
# If a mod is still failing, see [[Modding:Help]] for general help or the [https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/ unofficial update thread] if it's marked incompatible.

==For mod authors==
The data for the [https://smapi.io/mods mod compatibility list] is maintained in the {{github|Pathoschild/SmapiCompatibilityList|Pathoschild/SmapiCompatibilityList repo}} on GitHub. Contributions are welcome if you notice something is outdated or missing!
